title: Privacy Policy
intro: This policy explains what information Phyllis J. Outlaw & Associates (“the firm,” “we”) receives when you visit pjoutlawlegal.com or make a payment through it, and how that information is used.

sections.heading: Information you choose to send us
sections.body:
The website does not have a contact form. If you call, fax or e-mail the office, we receive the information you choose to share, such as your name, contact details and the reason for your inquiry. We use it to respond to you and, if you become a client, to provide our services.

Please do not send confidential or time-sensitive details about a legal matter by e-mail or fax before the firm has agreed to represent you.

sections.heading: Online payments
sections.body:
When you pay through the Online Payment page, you enter your name, a payment description, the amount, and your billing ZIP code. Payments are processed by PayPal. Card and bank details are entered into PayPal’s secure payment fields and go directly to PayPal; the firm does not receive or store your full card number. PayPal’s use of your information is governed by PayPal’s own privacy statement.

The firm receives a record of the payment (such as your name, the amount, the description and the payment status) to apply it to your account.

sections.heading: Information collected automatically
sections.body:
Like most websites, the companies that host and deliver this site keep standard technical logs, such as your IP address, browser type and the pages requested, to operate and secure the service. The site’s fonts are loaded from Google Fonts, which means your browser connects to Google’s servers.

The website does not currently use analytics, advertising or tracking cookies. If that changes, this policy will be updated first.

sections.heading: How information is shared
sections.body: We do not sell personal information. We share it only with service providers who help us run the website and process payments (such as our hosting provider and PayPal), when you ask us to, or when the law requires it.

sections.heading: How long information is kept
sections.body: Information related to legal matters and payments is kept for as long as needed to provide our services and to meet our professional and legal record-keeping obligations.

sections.heading: Children
sections.body: This website is intended for adults. We do not knowingly collect information from children under 13.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top of this page shows when it was last changed.

sections.heading: Contact us
sections.body: Questions about this policy or your information can be directed to the office using the phone number or e-mail address shown at the bottom of this page.
